messages:
lina: :mega: Heads-up — we pushed a small CLI/config clarifying patch for the SDK today (sdk-cli 1.6.2). Not a model change, but a default flag behavior changed that can affect custom deploy scripts.
shawn: which flag changed?
lina: --cache-policy default moved from 'auto' -> 'prefer-cache' for low-latency profiles. This helps most apps but breaks a couple internal scripts that relied on full bypass.
kevin: are we treating this as breaking?
lina: Not a hard breaking in our semver (patch), but it is behavioral. Docs updated and we added a migration snippet + compatibility shim. Recommend teams pin 1.6.1 if they need prior behaviour.
marie: where's the docs note?
docs-bot: docs PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/912 — "CLI: clarify cache-policy default and add compatibility shim". Updated CLI reference + changelog.
kevin: thanks — can you paste the shim example here?
lina: sure — quick snippet you can add to CI to force old behavior:```bash
# enforce legacy cache behavior
redwood-cli config set cache-policy bypass || true
# pin to 1.6.1 in CI until you opt-in
pip install redwood-sdk-cli==1.6.1
```
shawn: will this affect Dedicated customers?
lina: Dedicated/private control plane unaffected; this change is in the open-source CLI shipped with hosted SDK. We patched the hosted routing API to be explicit so hosted apps won't flip unexpectedly.
ops-bot: Deploy job r2-docs-site succeeded (job 4234) — docs updated at https://docs.redwood.ai/cli/config#cache-policy
marie: migration checklist for infra: 1) scan CI for explicit reliance on cache-bypass flags, 2) either pin 1.6.1 or apply shim, 3) schedule opt-in to new default in next sprint.
kevin: can we add a short note to the SDK changelog about recommended timing and risk level?
docs-bot: changelog updated in PR 912 with "risk: low, recommended: opt-in within 30 days"
shawn: i'll post a short announcement in #eng-platform and ping major internal consumers.
lina: thanks — FYI we'll auto-deprecate the shim in 90 days; if anyone needs a longer runway DM me. :thumbsup:
